mapper.select: INSERT INTO generation_jobs (job_id, project_id, job_type, status, resource_class, progress, current_step, error_code, requested_by_user_id, story_version_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, source_language, idempotency_key, storyboard_revision_id, media_plan_id, media_plan_revision, production_mode, analysis_visual_generation_mode, analysis_image_provider) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{projectId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{resourceClass}, #{progress}, #{currentStep}, #{errorCode}, #{requestedByUserId}, #{storyVersionId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterRowVersion}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceText}, #{sourceLanguage}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{storyboardRevisionId}, #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaPlanRevision}, #{productionMode}, #{analysisVisualGenerationMode}, #{analysisImageProvider}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_jobs SET job_id = #{jobId}, project_id = #{projectId}, job_type = #{type}, status = #{status}, resource_class = #{resourceClass}, progress = #{progress}, current_step = #{currentStep}, error_code = #{errorCode}, requested_by_user_id = #{requestedByUserId}, story_version_id = #{storyVersionId}, chapter_id = #{chapterId}, chapter_row_version = #{chapterRowVersion}, source_hash = #{sourceHash}, source_text = #{sourceText}, source_language = #{sourceLanguage}, idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, storyboard_revision_id = #{storyboardRevisionId}, media_plan_id = #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, media_plan_revision = #{mediaPlanRevision}, production_mode = #{productionMode}, analysis_visual_generation_mode = #{analysisVisualGenerationMode}, analysis_image_provider = #{analysisImageProvider}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN j.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'MATERIALIZATION' WHEN NOT COALESCE(stats.structure_complete, FALSE) THEN 'STRUCTURE' WHEN COALESCE(stats.total_shards, 0) = 0 THEN 'BOUNDARIES' WHEN COALESCE(stats.completed_shards, 0) < COALESCE(stats.total_shards, 0) THEN 'SHARDS' ELSE 'VALIDATION' END AS phase, COALESCE(stats.completed_shards, 0) AS completed_shards, COALESCE(stats.total_shards, 0) AS total_shards, LEAST( COALESCE(stats.reused_shards, 0), COALESCE(stats.completed_shards, 0) ) AS reused_shards, COALESCE(stats.repair_count, 0) AS repair_count, report.continuity_report_id, 'continuity-v1' AS pipeline_version FROM generation_jobs j JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ( split_part(ac.step_key, ':', 2) || ':' || split_part(ac.step_key, ':', 3) )) FILTER ( WHERE ac.step_key LIKE 'shard:%' OR ac.step_key LIKE 'repair:%' )::INTEGER AS total_shards, COUNT(DISTINCT ( split_part(ac.step_key, ':', 2) || ':' || split_part(ac.step_key, ':', 3) )) FILTER ( WHERE (ac.step_key LIKE 'shard:%' OR ac.step_key LIKE 'repair:%') AND ac.status = 'COMPLETED' )::INTEGER AS completed_shards, COUNT(DISTINCT ( split_part(ac.step_key, ':', 2) || ':' || split_part(ac.step_key, ':', 3) )) FILTER ( WHERE (ac.step_key LIKE 'shard:%' OR ac.step_key LIKE 'repair:%') AND ac.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ac.lease_version > 1 )::INTEGER AS reused_shards, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ac.step_key LIKE 'repair:%')::INTEGER AS repair_count, BOOL_OR( ac.status = 'COMPLETED' AND (ac.step_key = 'structure' OR ac.step_key LIKE 'structure-repair:%') ) AS structure_complete FROM analysis_checkpoints ac WHERE ac.generation_job_id = j.id ) stats ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cr.id AS continuity_report_id FROM chapter_continuity_plans ccp JOIN continuity_reports cr ON cr.plan_id = ccp.id WHERE ccp.chapter_id = j.chapter_id AND ccp.story_version_id = j.story_version_id AND ccp.storyboard_revision_id = j.storyboard_revision_id AND ccp.source_hash = j.source_hash ORDER BY ccp.revision DESC, cr.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) report ON TRUE WHERE j.job_id = #{jobId} AND j.job_type = 'CHAPTER_ANALYZE' AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL
